name: Time Is A Circle extends Continuum spells when Wand of Time is cast (#3608)
contract: Time Is A Circle 806206 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on 524962 (named "Wand Master" in Spell.dbc, a stale label), which carries three effect 177 entries (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_DURATION), each EffectBasePoints 2999 / DieSides 1 (3000 ms), with EffectMiscValue 806203 (Paradox Cannon), 804435 (Flux Emitter) and 804436 (Aether Compression). Spell.dbc gives 806206's record ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the extension could never fire. With a spell_proc row on the cast phase of Wand of Time (family 28, word1 0x100000, carried by 520175 and every rank) at the record's own 100% ProcChance, casting Wand of Time must raise Flux Emitter's remaining duration instead of letting it decay. Flux Emitter carries CasterAuraSpell 804455 (Echo Fragment), fixtured with set_aura; five stacks also give it the per-fragment duration bonus (Echo Fragment's effect 1 is SPELLMOD_DURATION, 5000 ms per stack) so its DurationIndex 28 base of 5000 ms becomes long enough to observe. The assertion is relative to a snapshot taken 1.5 s later: without the fix the remaining duration can only have fallen, so a positive delta discriminates and needs no randomness.
